core_obligations: Affine case (proof lines 9624-9632): the Artin-Schreier sequence identifies the mod p cohomology with the cohomology of the structure sheaf twisted by Frobenius, which vanishes in degrees at least two on an affine scheme.

Dimension bound (proof lines 9632-9638): for a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme of dimension d the author uses a covering by finitely many affine opens with bounded intersections and the spectral sequence of that covering, together with the affine case, to obtain vanishing above 2 + d.
proof_roadmap: Use the Artin-Schreier sequence to reduce to the cohomology of the structure sheaf.
Apply the vanishing on affine schemes to get the first assertion.
Cover a quasi-compact scheme of dimension d and use the resulting spectral sequence for the bound.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a scheme of characteristic p the mod p etale cohomology vanishes above degree one when the scheme is affine and above 2 + d for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme of dimension d (statement lines 9611-9622). The proof uses the Artin-Schreier sequence to reduce to the cohomology of the structure sheaf and applies the vanishing on affine schemes for the first assertion (proof lines 9624-9632), then covers a quasi-compact scheme of dimension d by finitely many affine opens and uses the associated spectral sequence to obtain the dimension bound (proof lines 9632-9638). The non-formal content is the passage from the affine case to the dimension bound. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one covering argument.
